name: @abolishus/contracts
description: Abolish's contracts (Foundry): the event accumulator, the election, trustee and group registries, the direct-submit board, the L1 board anchor and the L1 relay so far, with their wagmi bindings (P1-18).

scripts.build: forge build && rm -rf out/build-info && wagmi generate && vp fmt src/generated
scripts.test: forge test && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=precompile EXPECT_P256VERIFY=true forge test --match-path test/TrusteeRegistry.t.sol && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=precompile EXPECT_P256VERIFY=true forge test --match-path 'test/{MembershipProof,BallotCheck,Board,BoardAvailability,BoardCloseRule,Tier1Additions,NullifierKeys,ElectionRegistryAuthorPanel,BoardBallotV4}.t.sol' && vp test run
